title: 第一卷 人生初见 第二十一章 囚徒 无名第一卷 人生初见 第二十二章 原石
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
灰色沙地。
地面忽然传来剧烈的震动，空中传来轰隆隆的响声。
长孙从昏迷中醒来，来不及确认自己身体怎么样，便急忙寻找初黎。
所幸初黎就在身边，长孙赶紧背起初黎，向着响声处望去。
在这片寂静之地遇到这样的动静实属稀奇，长孙望了许久依然是只闻其声，并没有看到什么。
犹豫了片刻，长孙便背起初黎，调转方向，向着发出响声的方向走去。
长孙这时才发现自己身体发生了变化。
长孙最先注意到的是丹田内的真气漩涡已经不见踪影，昏迷前虽然长孙的身体处在极度干涸的状态，但出于自身的保护，真气漩涡会留下一丝真气，处于缓慢旋转的状态，当灵气充沛的条件下，真气漩涡便会重新高速旋转起来，而此刻的真气漩涡却消失了。
让长孙感到奇怪的是丹田看起来没有变化，但长孙却感觉丹田似乎变大了许多。
其次长孙感觉身体不再那么虚弱，体内的每一寸肌肉充满了力量。
长孙边走边感受身体的变化，但长孙同时也发现周围的灰雾仿佛是变重了一般，长孙感觉就像是在水中行走一般，行动处处都受阻力。
长孙想到，刚来到此处怎么没有此般感受，然后才发觉先前传家宝散发的光芒已经消失了。
长孙赶忙从胸前掏出传家宝，虽然这个传家宝一直被长孙称为“掏耳勺”，但爷爷在交给自己前特意叮嘱要保护好它，并且这次的经历充分的证明自家这个传家宝的不凡。
长孙一摸发现传家宝还在，心安定了下来，掏出来一看，发现传家宝竟也发生了变化。
之前的传家宝像是玉石一般散着光泽，而此刻的传家宝变得像是燃尽的炉渣，成了灰黑色，看起来粗糙不堪，但入手却如同玉石一般圆润，形成极大的反差。
长孙研究半天也没研究出名堂，便将传家宝重新戴回颈上，向着发出声响的方向继续走去。
长孙不知又走了多久，感觉渐渐的靠近了声响，慢慢的放慢脚步，虽然在这个一成不变的寂静之地遇到一丝声响，让长孙感到无比亲切，但长孙却也不知道这代表这危险还是生机。
长孙小心翼翼的靠近，忽然一座石质的大门出现在眼前，它就像是突然出现一般，闯入长孙视野。
巨大的声响便是从这发出，而让长孙感到惊讶的是这座大门竟然在移动。
长孙看着大门一点一点向自己靠近，当它靠近自己时，长孙才看清。

这座大门竟有三层楼那么高，门的两边用两条粗粗的铁链拴着，长孙顺着铁链向前看，才发现在门的前面竟然还有一个人，这座石质的大门便是由这个人用铁链拖着向前移动。
长孙犹豫再三，还是鼓起勇气向这个人走去。
当走到他面前时，长孙双手抱拳，躬身向面前人行礼。
“前辈，晚辈长孙，误入此地，不知出路在何处，还望前辈明示。”
只见长孙面前的人，一袭黑袍加身，将自己完全隐藏于黑袍之下，黑袍的帽檐压得很低，连脸庞也完全藏在帽檐的阴影下。
黑袍人顿了顿，并未开口，而是抬起左手指了指前方，又指了指自己，再指了指身后的门，最后指了指长孙。
长孙呆立原地，似是有所感悟，又像是没有抓住，站在原地思索良久，再看时，发现黑袍人已经走出了一阵。
长孙快步跟上，落后黑袍人半个身位，以示尊重，边走边思索刚才黑袍人所指有何深意。
长孙跟着黑袍人走了很久，似是想到了什么，快步走到黑袍人面前，拦住他说道：“前辈，刚才晚辈一直在想前辈所指为何，晚辈愚钝有些所得。前辈是否在说，路一直在自己脚下，只有向前走才能找到自己人生的方向，当你感到迷茫的时候不要忘了回头看看，可能出口就在你的身后。”
长孙看了看黑袍人身后的门。
是啊，每个人都在向前赶路，但总会不知不觉忘了回头看看自己身后走过的路，前世的常岁便是这样，当他站在大楼上纵身一跃前，如果回头看看自己创下的商业帝国还有那些支持自己的合作伙伴，可能便不会走出那一步。
长孙回头看看背上的初黎，今生你便是我唯一的出路。
黑袍人听了长孙的话，似是有所感，想要张口说话，但像是很久没有开口了，张了张嘴却没有发出声音，而后用力的清了清嗓子，但开口时声音依旧显得生硬。
“我…我只是想说，我要往前走，你不要挡我的路，你要是懂得尊老爱幼就帮我推推这石门。”
“啊…啊？？”
长孙听完后呆立当场，半天才反应过来，心中一万头草泥马奔过。
“我…我思考了那么久，您就跟我说这个？？”长孙忍住心中骂娘的冲动。
“我也不明白这么简单的意思你怎么想这么久。”黑袍人说道。
content_en:
Gray sand.
Suddenly there was a violent vibration on the ground and a rumble in the air.
Changsun woke up from a coma. He didn't have time to confirm how he was doing, so he hurriedly looked for Chuli.
Fortunately, Chu Li was by his side. Changsun quickly carried Chu Li on his back and looked toward the sound.
It was unusual to encounter such movement in this quiet place. Changsun looked at it for a long time and still only heard its sound and saw nothing.
After hesitating for a moment, Changsun carried Chu Li on his back, turned around, and walked towards the direction of the noise.
Only then did the eldest grandson realize that his body had changed.
The first thing Changsun noticed was that the Zhenqi vortex in his Dantian had disappeared. Although Changsun's body was in an extremely dry state before coma, for his own protection, the Zhenqi vortex would leave a trace of Zhenqi in a slowly rotating state. When there was sufficient spiritual energy, the Zhenqi vortex would spin at high speed again, but at this moment the Zhenqi vortex had disappeared.
What makes the eldest grandson feel strange is that the dantian seems to have not changed, but the eldest grandson feels that the dantian seems to have become much larger.
Secondly, Changsun felt that his body was no longer so weak, and every muscle in his body was full of strength.
Changsun felt the changes in his body while walking, but at the same time, Changsun also found that the gray fog around him seemed to have become heavier. Changsun felt as if he was walking in water, and his movements were hindered everywhere.
The eldest grandson thought about why he didn't feel this way when he first came here, and then realized that the light emitted by the family heirloom had disappeared.
The eldest grandson quickly took out the family heirloom from his chest. Although the eldest grandson had always called this heirloom an "ear picker," his grandfather specifically told him to protect it before giving it to him. This experience fully proved the extraordinary nature of his family heirloom.
When the eldest grandson touched it and found that the heirloom was still there, he felt relieved. He took it out and took a look and found that the heirloom had also changed.
The previous heirloom was as lustrous as jade, but now the heirloom has become like burnt slag, turning gray-black and rough in appearance, but it is as round as jade in the hand, creating a great contrast.
The eldest grandson studied for a long time but failed to find out what the name was, so he put the heirloom back on his neck and continued walking in the direction of the sound.
The eldest grandson didn't know how long he had been walking. He felt that he was getting closer to the sound and slowly slowed down his pace. Although the eldest grandson felt extremely friendly when encountering a sound in this unchanging and silent place, the eldest grandson didn't know whether it meant danger or life.
Changsun approached cautiously, and suddenly a stone door appeared in front of him. It seemed to have appeared suddenly and broke into Changsun's field of vision.
The huge noise came from here, and what surprised Changsun was that the gate was actually moving.
The eldest grandson watched the door getting closer to him little by little. When it got closer to him, the eldest grandson saw it clearly.
The gate was as high as three stories. The two sides of the door were tied with two thick iron chains. Changsun looked forward along the iron chains, only to find that there was another person in front of the door. This person was dragging the stone gate forward with the iron chains.
Changsun hesitated again and again, but finally mustered up the courage to walk towards this man.
When he walked in front of him, Changsun clasped his hands and bowed to salute the person in front of him.
"Senior, the eldest grandson of this junior, entered this place by mistake. I don't know where the way out is. I hope senior will make it clear."
The person in front of Changsun was seen wearing a black robe, completely hiding himself under the black robe. The brim of the black robe was pressed very low, and even his face was completely hidden under the shadow of the brim.
The man in black robe paused and did not speak. Instead, he raised his left hand and pointed forward, then to himself, then to the door behind him, and finally to his eldest grandson.
The eldest grandson stood there blankly, as if he had some realization, but also seemed not to grasp it. He stood there and thought for a long time. When he looked again, he found that the man in black robe had already walked out for a while.
Changsun followed quickly, half a body behind the man in black robe.To show respect, while walking, he thought about the profound meaning of what the man in black robe just pointed out.
The eldest grandson followed the man in black robe for a long time, and seemed to have thought of something. He walked quickly to the man in black robe, stopped him and said, "Senior, I have been thinking about what my senior was referring to just now. I have gained something from my stupidity. Are you saying that the road is always under your feet, and you can only find the direction of your life by moving forward. When you feel confused, don't forget to look back. The exit may be behind you."
Changsun looked at the door behind the black-robed man.
Yes, everyone is rushing forward, but they always forget to look back at the road they have walked behind them. This was the case with Chang Sui in his previous life. When he stood on the building and jumped, if he looked back at the business empire he created and the partners who supported him, he might not have taken that step.
Changsun looked back at Chuli on his back, "You are my only way out in this life."
The man in black robe seemed to feel something after hearing Changsun's words. He wanted to open his mouth to speak, but it seemed that he had not spoken for a long time. When he opened his mouth, no sound came out. Then he cleared his throat vigorously, but his voice still sounded stiff when he spoke.
"I...I just want to say, I want to move forward, don't block my way, if you know how to respect the old and care for the young, help me push this stone door."
"Ah...ah??"
After hearing this, the eldest grandson stood dumbfounded on the spot. It took him a long time to realize what he was saying, and in his heart ten thousand grass-mud horses were running through him.
"I...I've been thinking about it for so long, and you're just going to tell me this?" Zhangsun resisted the urge to curse in his heart.
"I don't understand why you thought about such a simple meaning for so long." The man in black robe said.
